I stacked hopoo feathers and rusty jetpacks until I could cross the map by air 10 times without touching the ground.

I stacked barbed wire until it filled the whole screen.

I stacked used item cdr until I could permanantly make myself invincible. 

I took Artifact of Command off and died on the second stage. 

10/10

(Also, for those saying the multiplayer is broken, it's fixed now, I ran a server for my friends who purchased it during the summer sale. There were a few crashes, but I believe that was because of my crappy internet.)

Basically, you are a grandma who is contemplating whether to go outside or not. The weather app on her new-fangled phone said there is a Risk of Rain.
10/10 WeatherApp

P.S.

The level where the cats are stuck on the roof (level 33?) is really hard. The last cat to rescue is named Providence and hes a massive ♥♥♥♥♥. He doesn't even want to be rescued!

A cool little indie game I beat after about 3 hours without too much trouble. The game is pretty hard I was just lucky I guess. At least not at first. At first I wanted to quit for good because it was just too frustrating, but I found out that you just have to get through the first two stages and hope you get some of the better items before you get deeper into the game. That and it is crucial to find the floating bots and repair them to help you out. After I had the bots helping me, my weapon and skills started to become so ineffectual that the bots were easily accounting for at least 95% of my dmg output. It got to a point where there were so many enemies and they took so much dmg that without any bots helping me the game would actually be unbeatable. The game's main problem is that when you get to the third stage, the ice stage usually, the difficulty spikes to unacceptably hard. I triggered the boss and of course other things spawn in when he is there so since it was the colossus I was able to take them away from him and focus on them. Problem is in that level because of the difficulty spike they take too much dmg to kill, are too many of them, and were shooting undodge-able projectiles which killed me in a few hits. So if I have to clear not only the boss but also all of the enemies but they made it impossible on that part and screwed me over purposely, why even make a ♥♥♥♥♥♥♥ game in the first place? That is as of 2015. I beat the game back in 2014 and honestly can't even believe I beat it as impossible as that level is.

I unlocked the enforcer, the bandit, the sniper, the engineer, and the huntress. Besides the engineer and huntress, they all sucked and seemed more like backup classes for online play. The thing that stands out most about the game is its killer soundtrack. A very unique indie game. I've never seen anything like it and it is a blast.
